title: Google Map Theme
text:
## Google Map Theme
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000010586
The Google Map Theme Setting allows the admin to select a theme for the directory maps.
Settings
Design Settings
General Tab
Main Design
Google Map Theme
Click on the drop down on the setting named "Google Map Theme", select the preferred theme:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12101451802/original/yTxuPkbAqr9l2PMIR5PpP_s7_x2IATmKiA.png?1637805002 | alt: ]

## Maps Themes
The available options are:
Classic
Apple View
Modern Colors View
Midnight Colors View
Black and White Colors View

## Classic View
This option will select the Classic View, which is a timeless rendition with familiar map features and a traditional color scheme.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005899832/original/blob1464985885386.png?1464985886 | alt: ]

## Apple View
This option will select the Apple View, which emulates the aesthetics of Apple Maps, offering a clean and familiar design.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005899842/original/blob1464985920745.png?1464985921 | alt: ]

## Modern Colors View
This option selects the Modern Colors View, which is vibrant and contemporary, presenting map data with fresh and lively hues.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005899881/original/blob1464986051073.png?1464986052 | alt: ]

## Midnight Colors View
This option selects the Midnight Colors View, which evokes a sense of nightfall with deep, subdued tones for a sophisticated look.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12139509990/original/0zyuUMRWC7SEHSB2zTXcww_D_vYJfgbKFQ.jpg?1709269771 | alt: ]

## Black & White Colors View
This option selects the Black and White Colors View, which is a minimalist approach, highlighting map details in stark monochrome contrast.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005899895/original/blob1464986095613.png?1464986096 | alt: ]
